scope_reviewed: Direito Romano root README, corpus manifest, and comparative index
all three tower control records, claim ledgers, definition cards, worked examples, learning packs, and open residue
Refine seed/run artifacts and Strategy Inventory Packet
findings: Initial persisted families should be Source, Tower, Claim, DefinitionCard, WorkedExample, OpenResidue, and PageCitation; learner questions and attempts are a separate overlay.
Topic, StudyRoute, Prerequisite, Exception/Counterexample, and generic Evidence should begin as derived projections or provenance records, not independent authoritative nodes.
Minimum relations are belongs-to-tower, tower-uses-source, assertion-supported-by-page, claim-classified-as, residue-owned-by, and explicitly evidenced related-source.
Identity must combine immutable source SHA-256, tower slug, artifact path, record kind, and local ID or deterministic selector; input order must never define identity.
Every assertion edge needs source hash, physical page/range, tower artifact selector, evidence taxonomy, and extraction status; OCR uncertainty must propagate.
